title: A write the plugin answers with ok:false and landed:true is recorded as unknown, not as a clean refusal: Site changes keeps it, the site is stamped as written and the write lease is kept
steps: S1: run apps/tracy-web/test/review-apply-write-door.test.mjs: a move-and-rename answered write_failed with landed:true, the same answer without the flag, and landed on an ok answer.
expect: S1: landed flag gives outcome unknown, last_write_at set, lease holder kept; no flag gives refused, no stamp, lease freed; ok answer stays ok.
evidence: 22/10/2026: two writes of a real imported Joomla site were refused (bad_params, write_failed) and passed on retry; the test for a write_failed that part landed was marked todo because the door recorded it as refused.
fence: Only an explicit landed:true changes the outcome; an answer without it is read exactly as before

tests: a plugin 'write_failed' flagged landed is recorded as a change that may have happened, keeps the lease and moves the stamp
a plugin 'write_failed' with no landed flag is still a clean refusal: the lease goes back, no stamp
a landed flag on an answer that is ok, or is not a write failure, changes nothing
